# Provek

> Verification of how much of a business runs without a human in the loop, established from
> evidence rather than from a claim. The registry and every passport are meant to be found and
> quoted. Nothing here is meant to be trained on: see Content-Signal in /robots.txt - a verdict
> baked into model weights has no field it can go stale in, and every passport here does.

## Pages

- [Registry](https://provek.dev/registry/): every subject submitted, what could be established about each, and why not where it could not.
- [Method](https://provek.dev/method/): how a level is assigned to an operation, how evidence is classed, and what the score does not measure.
- [Build](https://provek.dev/build/): AI agent templates - copy one instruction into your own coding agent, get an agent that runs one business operation. Free, no account.
- [Apply](https://provek.dev/apply/): request verification. Free at this stage. Public repositories only.
- [Phase 2](https://provek.dev/phase-2/): live: the Provider Catalog (a verified subject may publish an Order link).
- [Phase 3](https://provek.dev/phase-2/#phase-3): specified, not in service - no application taken, no date given.
- [Corrections](https://provek.dev/registry/corrections/): every erratum the project has published, in full.
- [Challenge](https://provek.dev/challenge/): the open verification challenge - free, public, open to any business whose operations run through agents.
- [Witness](https://provek.dev/witness/): the GenLayer Evidence Witness - validators independently check an evidence URL and must agree before a record is written. Contract explorer: https://scan.bradbury.genlayer.com/address/0x499eD0E23CbCdC8Fc7735709dca32bCb01638fd6 (pre-reset network; redeploy pending).
- [Autonomy levels L0-L5](https://provek.dev/method/notes/autonomy-levels-l0-l5/): what each rung requires as evidence, and which thresholds are assigned rather than measured.
- [Four states of absence](https://provek.dev/method/notes/not-measured-is-not-zero/): why a measurement that is absent is not a zero.
- [ERC-8004](https://provek.dev/method/notes/what-erc-8004-provides-and-what-it-does-not/): what ERC-8004 standardizes, and what it leaves to a validator.

## Templates

- [Customer Support Agent](https://provek.dev/build/customer-support-agent/): customer support: inbound email triage and reply drafting. Raw: https://provek.dev/build/customer-support-agent/SKILL.md
- [Lead Generation Agent](https://provek.dev/build/lead-generation-agent/): lead generation: sourcing, enriching, and qualifying leads against a stated ideal customer profile, then drafting first-touch outreach. Raw: https://provek.dev/build/lead-generation-agent/SKILL.md
- [Ecommerce Operations Agent](https://provek.dev/build/ecommerce-operations-agent/): e-commerce back office: performance summaries, listing hygiene, inventory/order alerts, and price-change proposals, all behind a human approval gate. Raw: https://provek.dev/build/ecommerce-operations-agent/SKILL.md
- [Market Research Agent](https://provek.dev/build/market-research-agent/): market/competitor research: a recurring brief produced by asking several models the same questions independently, having them review each other's anonymized answers, and combining the results into one sourced document. Raw: https://provek.dev/build/market-research-agent/SKILL.md
- [Content Production Agent](https://provek.dev/build/content-production-agent/): content production: drafting an article from a brief, checking every factual claim against the sources it cites, and queuing the result for a human to publish. Raw: https://provek.dev/build/content-production-agent/SKILL.md
- [Finance Operations Agent](https://provek.dev/build/finance-operations-agent/): finance back office: invoice intake, categorization against a chart of accounts, and a reconciliation report comparing books to a bank/card statement export - it never moves money. Raw: https://provek.dev/build/finance-operations-agent/SKILL.md
- [YouTube Channel Operations Agent](https://provek.dev/build/youtube-channel-operations-agent/): YouTube channel operations: taking a finished video and its metadata, tracking the channel's daily API quota, uploading it as unlisted, and handing the decision to make it public to a human. Raw: https://provek.dev/build/youtube-channel-operations-agent/SKILL.md
- Skills index (Agent Skills Discovery 0.2.0): https://provek.dev/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json

## API

- [API catalog](https://provek.dev/.well-known/api-catalog): RFC 9727 linkset of every resource above and the one endpoint below.
- [/api/apply](https://provek.dev/api/apply): submit a subject for verification. GET -> 405. Empty POST -> 400.
- `GET /api/apply/<id>` -> state of one request, by its id (the id POST /api/apply returned; never the contact).
